data.name: Rapid Adjustment
data.description: You can, as a swift action, alter your astral suit's customization to better allow you to follow prey or respond to changing environments, butyou are limited to the list of customizations below when doing so.  The customization being lost and the customization being gained must both be in the list below.  The customizations the trailblazer can select from are Burrow, Chameleon, Climb, Darkvision, Flight, Speed, Swim, Underwater Breath.
